snippets.label: On Enter Room
snippets.description: Fires when the player enters a tagged room.
snippets.lua_template:
-- @node id="{id}" type="trigger:trigger_on_enter_room" x={x} y={y}
-- @params room_tag="{room_tag}"
engine.subscribe("player_moved", function(payload)
  local tile = engine.get_tile(payload.to.x, payload.to.y)
  if tile and tile.room_tag == "{room_tag}" then
    -- node body continues below
  end
end)
-- @endnode
